faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Our Support
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before partnering with WEZO MEDIA.
faq.q1: What does an integrated digital marketing agency like WEZO MEDIA actually do?
faq.a1: Unlike single-tactic freelancers, WEZO MEDIA manages the complete value chain: understanding your market, crafting the strategy, producing creative content and videos, setting up and scaling paid ad campaigns, engineering high-converting landing pages, and providing continuous data analytics. You gain an accountable partner who coordinates all required specializations seamlessly.
faq.q2: How much does digital marketing support cost in Morocco?
faq.a2: Cost is directly tied to the scope of your business and the active pillars required (strategic depth, content volume, ad campaign management, web infrastructure). We do not offer cheap, throwaway packages: each engagement is custom-scoped following your project review to ensure an investment return that makes economic sense for your margins.
faq.q3: What advertising budget should we plan for paid campaigns?
faq.a3: Ad spend depends on your industry, competition density, and commercial targets. To test audiences properly and gather statistically valid conversion data in Morocco, we generally recommend an initial media spend of at least 3,000 to 5,000 MAD per month, scaling upward as profitability is systematically proven.
faq.q4: Can WEZO MEDIA handle both creative content and advertising campaigns?
faq.a4: Yes, that is the foundational premise of our integrated model. Over 70% of campaign performance hinges on creative relevance, messaging, and visual resonance. When the content creators and media buyers work within the same room, we eliminate friction and can iterate creatives rapidly based on live performance data.
faq.q5: Do you work with SMEs and local businesses?
faq.a5: Absolutely. A substantial portion of our clients are Moroccan SMEs, growing retail brands, clinics, and professional service companies looking to formalize and scale their customer acquisition without the prohibitive overhead of hiring a full in-house marketing department.
faq.q6: How does onboarding work with WEZO MEDIA?
faq.a6: The engagement begins with your online project review submission, followed by a strategic discovery call to diagnose your current bottlenecks. We then deliver a tailored roadmap highlighting high-priority intervention pillars. Once approved, our team moves directly into asset production and campaign infrastructure setup.
faq.q7: Does every client receive the same strategy or standardized template?
faq.a7: No, never. An e-commerce decor brand, a B2B corporate consultancy, and a private education facility have fundamentally different customer buying cycles and margin profiles. Every roadmap is built around your validated strengths, specific market bottlenecks, and financial goals.

proof_faq.title: Verified Case Studies & Frequently Asked Questions
proof_faq.subtitle: Real client engagements deployed in Morocco and direct, transparent answers to your questions.
proof_faq.c1_context: Moroccan home decor brand looking to scale online inquiries.
proof_faq.c1_scope: Ad creative art direction, product Reels editing, and campaign setup for cold acquisition and catalog retargeting.
proof_faq.c2_context: Preschool institution seeking to inform families in its immediate radius.
proof_faq.c2_scope: Radius-targeted local campaigns around the facility, reassuring creative assets, and direct parent inquiry funnel.
proof_faq.c3_context: Clinical practice seeking to structure its digital presence within strict medical ethics.
proof_faq.c3_scope: Sober and reassuring messaging, educational awareness campaigns, and a discreet, confidential booking channel.
proof_faq.q1: Do you guarantee a specific number of sales or leads?
proof_faq.a1: No, and no ethical agency can make such promises. Final sales outcomes depend on multiple external factors: your pricing, offer appeal, your sales team's responsiveness, and market competition. What we do guarantee is meticulous execution: sharp audience targeting, high-quality creatives, continuous testing, and transparent budget management.
proof_faq.q2: How is the ad budget paid to Meta?
proof_faq.a2: The media spend is paid directly by your company to Facebook/Meta using the credit card registered on your ad account. WEZO MEDIA fees strictly cover strategy, creative production, and campaign management. This ensures full financial transparency and control.
proof_faq.q3: What starting monthly ad budget should we plan for?
proof_faq.a3: As an indicative baseline, a media budget of 3,000 to 5,000 MAD per month in Morocco typically provides enough data to test multiple audiences and creatives. This amount is indicative and adjusts based on your geographic target, industry, and goals.
proof_faq.q4: Do you handle answering inbound WhatsApp messages?
proof_faq.a4: Our core responsibility is bringing qualified prospects into your WhatsApp chat with a clear introductory message. Closing sales and answering specific inquiries remains the role of your internal team who knows your business best.
proof_faq.q5: How soon can we expect the first inquiries?
proof_faq.a5: Once campaigns go live, initial inquiries can arrive within the first few days. However, the Meta algorithm generally requires a 2-to-4 week learning phase to stabilize costs and deliver consistent performance.
proof_faq.q6: Are Meta Pixel and Conversions API always included?
proof_faq.a6: Their implementation depends on your website infrastructure and the agreed quote scope. For campaigns driving leads directly to WhatsApp or Meta Instant Forms, tracking is natively handled within Meta.
proof_faq.q7: Is there a long-term binding contract?
proof_faq.a7: Our plans are flexible with no mandatory long-term lock-in. We recommend an initial 2-to-3 month period to allow sufficient algorithmic learning and creative optimization, with ongoing renewal based on your satisfaction.
